paragraphs: Playgarden Prep Online sells an online preschool program for children 2-4 years old to use at home. The program includes a private preschool curriculum, lessons with certified teachers, hands-on learning tools, and a daily learning schedule. Daily lessons run 27 weeks, and repeating some weeks is recommended. Pre-recorded daily lessons can be completed at any time of year, and Live Zoom classes are offered year-round.

The home page offers plans for families and, separately, plans for libraries, hospitals, and school. Access by library card number is offered as an alternative on the same page. A Play and Learn program is offered for families that want to complement the education their children receive at school or daycare.

Playgarden runs enrichment centers and preschools in New York City and online programs around the world, and says it has helped thousands of families over the last 15 years. Work on online access to the programs began in 2019, and they were made available to families in the fall of 2020.

quote.text: Playgarden makes it easy to teach your child reading, writing, math, and other Pre-K skills, all while staying active, engaged, and socializing.
